scoreSteps.title: Read
scoreSteps.body: Resumes, test answers and interview transcripts are turned into structured facts: skills, how recently they were used, and for how long.

scoreSteps.title: Match
scoreSteps.body: Those facts are compared with the role profile. Must-haves and nice-to-haves are weighted the way your hiring manager set them.

scoreSteps.title: Score
scoreSteps.body: Each criterion in your rubric gets a score, and each score links to the evidence it came from. Protected characteristics are never inputs.

scoreSteps.title: Review
scoreSteps.body: A recruiter sees the ranking and the reasons, can override any score, and makes the decision. The model never rejects anyone.

guardrails.title: Explainable by design
guardrails.body: If the system cannot show why a candidate ranked where they did, the feature does not ship.

guardrails.title: Audited for bias every quarter
guardrails.body: Pass-through rates are tested across monitored groups, and the results go to customers unedited.

guardrails.title: A human decides
guardrails.body: AI shortlists and recruiters choose. Proctoring flags are reviewed by a person before any action.

guardrails.title: Your data stays yours
guardrails.body: Candidate data is never used to train shared models, and can be held in the EU on request.

buildingBlocks.title: Open by default
buildingBlocks.body: A REST API and webhooks for every object in the platform, so your ATS and HRMS remain the system of record.

buildingBlocks.title: Built for hiring peaks
buildingBlocks.body: Screening and interviews scale with demand, so a seasonal wave of ten thousand applicants is scored as quickly as ten.

buildingBlocks.title: Enterprise sign-in and access
buildingBlocks.body: SSO / SAML, role-based permissions and a full audit trail of who saw and changed what.

researchTracks.title: Skills that transfer
researchTracks.body: Recognising when experience in one field predicts success in another, to widen talent pools for hard-to-fill roles.

researchTracks.title: Fairer voice interviews
researchTracks.body: Reducing the effect of accent and audio quality on transcription, so scoring depends on what was said.

researchTracks.title: Clearer candidate feedback
researchTracks.body: Turning rubric scores into feedback an unsuccessful candidate can actually use.
